title: CogStack — Persistent AI Cognition and Multi-Vendor Cognitive Stacking
description: A two-layer architecture for autonomous AI agent systems: a persistent cognition substrate (context compression, durable memory store, rehydration pipeline, headless execution daemon, plugin bus) and a multi-vendor cognitive-stacking model that orchestrates agents across providers for decorrelated diversity. Designed as the orchestration complement to AIDL. Published openly as a contribution and as prior art under the MIT License.
